properties.name: FIELD LOG 2026-10-06, recorded for cleanup pass 2: detect_defects counts an idea closed with a review note as an orphan, and an exploratory idea that deliberately CONTRADICTS an accepted decision (the brainstorm skill's way to reopen one) as a contradiction
properties.statement: Measured on 0.80.0 in the hub design: a brainstorm idea recorded with review_relations -> state reviewed_unlinked (the skill calls a note "a full answer") was still reported as orphan_node, raising structural defects 20 -> 21; an exploratory Decision that CONTRADICTS an accepted one, reopening it as instructed, was counted as a contradiction defect. Expected: neither counts against health, or both read as acknowledged. Same family as the cleanup pass 1 finding that a superseded Decision counts as neither parked nor followed through (heal.rs follow_through_exists) and fact:the-defect-count-is-severity-blind-so-parked-ideas-are-reported-as-outstanding-debt. Not root-caused yet; it belongs to cleanup pass 2.
